boundary.description: From the point where the railway crosses Crossley Road, E along Crossley Road, Stockport Road, Norfolk Avenue. Then by a beeline to and along Carnforth Road, Nelstrop Road, Broadstone Road, Manchester Road, Whitehill Street West, Greg Street, Birkdale Road, Sandy Lane, Willow Avenue and by a beeline to River Tame ( all Woodhall Crescent estate in St Mary’s parish). S by River Tame and River Mersey to M60 junction 1, then N to Green Lane and by a footpath N, continuing along Green Lane, Alexandra Road, Heaton Road to the railway and M by the railway to Crossley Road.
